_about: Pictured Knowledge: The New Method of Visual Instruction Applied to All School Subjects (Chicago: Compton-Johnson, 1919 printing, copyright 1916, 1917, 1919), the five-volume children's picture reference that became Compton's Pictured Encyclopedia. All five volumes from Internet Archive scans, raw OCR; pictures and captions are kept only as text. Added 2026-10-23 at Adam's ask for old children's sets (the fact sets).
